default: Use vocabulary attested in the frozen 23-paper corpus; prefer main-text usage and plain economic language.
exception_rule: An exception must name the exact term, explain why no attested alternative preserves the meaning, identify its necessary use, and record an explicit approval. Do not add exemptions automatically.
concept_rule: Attested component words do not authorize a new technical concept, compound, assumption, or estimand. Introduce technical terminology only when the argument requires it.
